'''Greg Bole Crush The Rebellion''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Greg Bole]]
* '''Published:''' July 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]]
* '''Strategy:''' Crush The Rebellion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH Crush The Rebellion Bole DS 1996.txt |Download]]
